description: Defines the MojoCdm class, a ContentDecryptionModule implementation that proxies to a mojom::ContentDecryptionModule, handling media decryption and session management via Mojo IPC.

classes.name: MojoCdm
classes.description: A class implementing ContentDecryptionModule and CdmContext, proxying to a Mojo ContentDecryptionModule for media decryption and session management.
